core_question: How do I replace shoelaces that are frayed and worn out? (secondary: How do I introduce a new cat to my resident cat without conflict?)
answer_summary: Pull the worn laces out through the eyelets and thread in a new pair of the correct length, lacing them in the shoe's original pattern.; after the topic shift: Keep the new cat isolated at first, swap scents via bedding, allow sniffing under a door, then use gradual supervised visual introductions before full face-to-face contact.
persona: sarcastic; writing in full careful sentences
